gloss: to collapse; to crumble; to break down

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {崩|くず}れていませんでした

definitions.explanation: For a structure or pile to fall apart and lose its shape.
For plans, order, health, or balance to fall apart.

definitions.gloss: to become disheveled; to lose form
definitions.explanation: For appearance, posture, or formation to become disordered.

notes:
{崩|くず}れる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to fall apart or lose form.

TRANSITIVE PAIR: ⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧ (to break down, demolish)
- {崩|くず}れる: The tower collapses.
- ⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧: I knock over the tower.

ASPECT (ている):
{崩|くず}れている indicates something has collapsed and remains in that state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [structure]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{崩|くず}れる — [structure] collapses
- [plan/health]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{崩|くず}れる — [plan/health] falls apart
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{崩|くず}れる (mountain collapses - landslide)
- ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{崩|くず}れる (weather deteriorates)
- ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧ (to get sick - transitive form)
- ⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{崩|くず}れる (posture breaks down)

NOTE: The expression ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧ uses the transitive form to mean "to become ill."
